name: Central Media Manager for Multisite
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Central Media Manager for Multisite enables all subsites in a WordPress multisite network to access and use a shared, centralized media library. This helps prevent media duplication, simplifies media management, and keeps your network more organized.

Features

  • Share a single media library across the entire network.
  • Prevent duplicate uploads across subsites.
  • Lightweight and easy to configure.
  • Designed specifically for WordPress multisite networks.
  • Developer-friendly and extendable.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/central-media-library/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Network Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in your multisite network dashboard.
  3. That’s it! All subsites will now use the central media library from the main site.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work on single-site WordPress installs?

No. This plugin is built exclusively for WordPress multisite networks.

Which site is used as the central media library?

The main (primary) site of the network acts as the central media hub.

Will this affect existing media files on subsites?

No. Existing files on subsites remain untouched. Only new uploads are directed to the central library.
